c9_d1_selection_calibration.funding_timestamp_rule: start <= funding_time <= exact archive_end_boundary; any later timestamp is forbidden

c9_guardrails: C9-D1 may open only the September 2024 UTC+8 FundingRate archive month for the eight frozen assets.
The exact 2024-09-30T16:00:00Z funding boundary event is permitted because it is on UTC date 2024-09-30.
Any funding timestamp later than 2024-09-30T16:00:00Z is forbidden.
Do not open July 2024 funding monthly body.
Do not open October 2024 funding monthly body.
No mark/index return, basis transition, strategy direction, threshold, event window or PnL may be computed in C9-D1.
selection_rule: Anything inspected for feature choice, parameter choice, candidate selection, sentinel design/outcome, variance estimation or MDE planning is nonpromotional for the resulting implementation.
